preconditions: selective acquisition does not require accepting terms or modifying a share
quarantined restricted workspace exists outside report artifacts

target_sample.participant_rule: Prefer one annotated video from each of 15 distinct participant groups; never exceed two per group; if grouping is unavailable the pilot cannot begin.
target_sample.eligible_pool: Videos represented in the release annotation table with usable file linkage; eligibility is defined without watching/listening.
target_sample.selection: Deterministic balanced allocation over metadata strata, then hash-order sampling using SHA-256(release_manifest_digest || protocol_id || internal_episode_key).
target_sample.adjustment_rule: Sample size may move within 12-18 only for access, byte-size, or empty-stratum constraints identified before content inspection; record the reason and preserve the hash order.

acquisition.preflight: HEAD or equivalent metadata first; acquire only selected files and required annotation/metadata tables.
acquisition.integrity: Record remote version/etag/size where exposed and local SHA-256 in the restricted manifest; never copy restricted paths or identifiers into reports.

measurement.asr_and_diarization: Fixed local pretrained measurement instruments are quarantined; humans correct timing/text/role. Instrument embeddings and features cannot enter learner data.
measurement.event_lag_anchor: utterance onset minus nearest adjudicated visible candidate boundary
measurement.double_annotation: All timing/speaker validation items and at least 20% of referential items, stratified by participant and speech/activity stratum.
measurement.adjudication: Blind independent coding first; adjudicate disagreements without changing the frozen status set.

stopping.early_stop: Stop only for privacy/terms violation, corrupt or absent audio/video, unresolvable participant grouping, or infeasible storage. Do not stop or expand based on lexical richness or apparent cue effect.
stopping.no_training: Do not train, fine-tune, probe, or compare any scientific learner or causal arm.

exports: Gate decisions and nonidentifying aggregates with uncertainty/coverage only; no media, transcript text, identifiers, exact timestamps, or small cells.
